Class ImportedDataset

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.ImportedDataset
public final class ImportedDataset extends Object
Normalized in-memory draft every importer produces; write(Path) is the single dataset-write call site. Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.importers.imported_dataset.ImportedDataset.

    • write

      public Path write(Path output, ProgressSink progress) throws IOException
      Write this draft to output via the single image-aware SpectralDataset.create(String, String, String, List, List, List, List) call site, optionally reporting per-section progress. Returns the written .tio path. When a writeDelegate is set, the write is routed through it (write-through importers).
      Throws:
      IOException
